title: An elliptic curve of rank $\geq 34$ and root number $-1$ over a quadratic field
summary: In this article, we find a quadratic twist over $\mathbb{Q}$ of rank $\geq 2$ (and $\geq 3$ assuming parity) of an elliptic curve $E/\mathbb{Q}$ of rank $\geq 32$, recently found by Elkies, Klagsbrun, and Li. We use a family of quadratic twists of rank $\geq 2$ over $\mathbb{Q}(t)$ constructed by Mestre to search for twists $E^D$ with root number $-1$, computing all root numbers without factoring the (very large) twisting parameter $D$.
